nodes.text:
Precautions You Should Take

✔️ Wear a mask in crowded areas.
✔️ Wash hands frequently and avoid touching your face.
✔️ Stay home if sick to protect others.
✔️ High-risk groups should avoid crowded spaces.
✔️ Vaccinate against other respiratory viruses (flu, RSV) if eligible.
